name: Expeditious Retreat
description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you cast this spell, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take the Dash action, doubling your movement speed for that turn.
effect: Magic in your stride. In a fight: 6 more squares of movement each turn for 10 rounds (concentration). On the road: you travel 30% faster for 2 hours.
notes: In combat (bonus action): +6 squares of movement a turn for 10 rounds. Concentration.
Out of combat: travel 30% faster for 2 hours, and the extra movement carries into any fight in that time.
